recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12718 unless Patient Care separately revisits the later Goal.outcome removal or migration guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12718 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU2 asking to rename Goal.outcomeCodeableConcept to Goal.outcomeCode.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit 4576ba4d2c changed the Goal spreadsheet source and stop-smoking example from Goal.outcomeCodeableConcept to Goal.outcomeCode. Current active source searches found no Goal.outcomeCodeableConcept references outside excluded historical/published archives.
additional_context: FHIR-12661 created the flattened Goal outcome code/reference shape immediately before FHIR-12718. Later Applied issue FHIR-37262 removed Goal.outcome altogether in commit 0d8e3756353, and current fhir.ini records no mapping for Goal.outcomeCode or Goal.outcomeReference because Goal.outcome was deleted.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing or remapping Goal.outcomeCode would conflict with the later approved Goal.outcome removal, and the obsolete Goal.outcomeCodeableConcept name is absent from current active Goal source.
